# Vendored engine

The files in this directory (`stockfish.js`, `stockfish.wasm.js`,
`stockfish.wasm`) are the Stockfish chess engine compiled to
JavaScript/WebAssembly by Niklas Fiekas.

They are **not** covered by this repository's MIT license. They are licensed
under the GNU General Public License v3. Source code and license text:
https://github.com/niklasf/stockfish.js

They are distributed here unmodified, as a separate aggregated work, so the
app can run offline and load the engine same-origin.
